content:
You are a domain driven design (DDD) expert.
Your task is to help the user step by step with creating domain models.

### Here is the explanation of the workflow:
1. The user will provide domain information.
2. Next You will carry out the modeling steps, but only once the user specifically requests it.

#### Modeling steps:
1. Extracting domain objects
2. Connections of domain objects using associations 
3. Grouping objects by subdomains
4. Definition of bounded contexts

Help me extract domain objects. Below I will provide domain information. 

#### Data:
This domain information covers the important domain events:
```json
{
  "domain-information": [
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to import and prepare fiscal data from multiple file formats, so that I can make government and organizational spending data available for public use.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to model and update the structure of my datasets, so that I can ensure data accuracy and compatibility with fiscal standards.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to review and correct my datasets after publication, so that I can keep published information accurate and trustworthy.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to manage the visibility of my datasets, so that I can control when they are ready for public access.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to automatically update published datasets when the source files change, so that data consumers always see current information.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to provide geographic and contextual information for datasets, so that users can visualize and interpret fiscal data spatially.",
    "As a Data Publisher, I want to validate uploaded files, so that I can identify and correct issues before publication.",
    "As a Platform Administrator, I want to oversee all published datasets, so that I can ensure compliance with platform policies and remove or hide inappropriate data.",
    "As a Platform Administrator, I want to handle requests for dataset removal or correction, so that the platform maintains data quality and legal compliance.",
    "As a Platform Administrator, I want to manage user roles and privileges, so that only authorized users can modify or publish datasets.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to search and filter public datasets by title or metadata, so that I can quickly find relevant fiscal data.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to visualize datasets as maps, treemaps, or charts, so that I can better understand spending patterns and trends.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to view clear textual explanations alongside visualizations, so that I can interpret the data correctly.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to compare data across years, currencies, or regions, so that I can analyze trends and relative values.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to download underlying data or charts, so that I can reuse them in my own research or reports.",
    "As a Data Consumer, I want to share dataset visualizations or filtered views with others, so that fiscal insights can reach a broader audience.",
    "As a Researcher, I want to access multiple related datasets through shared metadata, so that I can conduct cross-dataset analyses.",
    "As a Researcher, I want to normalize fiscal measures by population, area, or GDP, so that I can compare datasets fairly across contexts.",
    "As a Community Member, I want to learn from examples of fiscal data projects, so that I can apply similar approaches in my own transparency work.",
    "As a Community Member, I want to highlight and share open data initiatives, so that others can contribute to or learn from them.",
    "As a Developer, I want to access an API that exposes datasets and metadata, so that I can integrate fiscal data into external applications.",
    "As a Developer, I want to retrieve geographic and socioeconomic context through the API, so that I can enrich data-driven visualizations.",
    "As a Developer, I want to customize visualization styles and layouts, so that I can adapt the presentation to my organization’s branding.",
    "As an API User, I want to obtain normalized and aggregated fiscal measures, so that I can build comparative analyses and dashboards.",
    "As a Platform Stakeholder, I want to monitor the publication and usage of datasets, so that I can evaluate the platform’s impact on fiscal transparency."
  ]
}
```
